name: Should I choose MDF, wood, or PVC baseboards?
description: MDF is common for painted trim, wood gives a traditional look, and PVC is useful where moisture resistance matters.

mainEntity.name: Should I choose MDF, wood, or PVC baseboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: MDF is often chosen for painted trim because it is budget-friendly and smooth, while wood offers a more traditional look and better durability in some settings. PVC can be a good option where moisture is a concern, but the right choice depends on your room, finish, and budget.
